name: Duke University Fit Email and SMS
description: Fetch Duke University's public website, analyze why Duke is a strong fit for a student founder, then email and text the recommendation.

nodes.name: Schedule
nodes.notes: Run manually when you want to refresh the Duke fit analysis.

nodes.name: Fetch Duke Website
nodes.notes: Fetch Duke public website signals and build structured fit-analysis rows.

integrationSettings.inputJson: {"source_url":"https://www.duke.edu/","student_profile":"High-school founder building Cell AI Data; interested in AI workflow automation, entrepreneurship, data, business strategy, and research-backed products.","fallback_sample":true}

nodes.name: OpenAI Duke Fit Analyst
nodes.notes: Use Duke website facts and the student-founder profile to create a concise personal recommendation.

integrationSettings.dataPolicy: Use public Duke website facts only. Do not claim official admissions advantage.

nodes.name: Build Email and Text
nodes.notes: Extract OpenAI email and SMS fields. If AI is skipped, the script output already contains email and SMS fields.

nodes.name: Email and Text Duke Analysis
nodes.notes: Send the Duke fit analysis to email and T-Mobile text recipients.

nodes.name: Export Duke Fit Excel
nodes.notes: Export the Duke fit-analysis rows to Excel.

nodes.name: Write Duke Fit Log
nodes.notes: Record Duke fit analysis and delivery status.
